jobs.title: Senior Sales Specialist - Voice - DACH
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About DeepL Voice

DeepL Voice is shaping the future of real-time multilingual communication.

Built on DeepL’s world-leading translation quality, the Voice product line brings together Research, Engineering, Product, and GTM teams to deliver real-time speech-to-speech interpretation for meetings, live conversations, and developer integrations.

In just two years, DeepL Voice has launched its first customer-facing products and built reliable, low-latency real-time systems. We are now scaling globally—expanding adoption, opening new use cases, and defining a new product category in multilingual communication.

The Role

As a Senior Sales Specialist (Voice Product Evangelist), you will help bring DeepL Voice to market at scale.

This is a customer-facing GTM role focused on supporting sales teams across the DACH region, leading Voice-specific customer conversations, and helping organisations understand and adopt real-time translation. You will work closely with Core Account Executives, Product, and Marketing to shape how Voice is positioned, demonstrated, and sold.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives on Voice-related opportunities across enterprise customers

  • Lead Voice-specific discovery, demos, pilots, and customer presentations

  • Act as a subject-matter expert across DeepL Voice use cases (meetings, live conversations, APIs)

  • Support the creation and evolution of Voice sales materials, talk tracks, and playbooks

  • Enable sales teams through training sessions, deal support, and hands-on guidance

  • Represent DeepL Voice in customer meetings, workshops, and strategic engagements

  • Gather customer and field feedback to inform product positioning and roadmap discussions

What You Bring

  • 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, in an Account Executive or Specialist Sales role

  • Experience selling complex or emerging products that require customer education

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with both technical and business audiences

  • Ability to clearly articulate product value and real-world use cases

  • Comfort working cross-functionally in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • Experience / deep interest in voice, AI, real-time systems, or communication technologies plus API solution experience

  • Fluency in English and German

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JW2

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: CS Enablement Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
What is Leapsome?

Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams. Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.

Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone, and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

Join a high-growth SaaS scale-up and shape how our GTM teams learn, ramp, and perform. As part of the GTM Enablement team, your main focus will be Customer Success and Account Management: the teams responsible for retention and expansion. But enablement at Leapsome is a cross-functional job, so you'll also support Sales and work on initiatives that span the whole GTM org. You'll build enablement the way it should work in 2026, with AI at the core of how knowledge gets created, shared, and put into practice. Please note this opportunity is a 1-year limited contract.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and run enablement initiatives that make our CS Growth and CS Care teams measurably better at driving renewals and expansion

  • Build the structures (and the AI-assisted workflows behind them) that let the team scale: knowledge management, meeting formats, and initiative alignment across the GTM org

  • Own onboarding for new CS hires and cut ramp time with structured, AI-supported learning paths

  • Get deep into the Leapsome product and coach team members on real client calls, from call prep to feedback afterwards

  • Facilitate regular team workshops and trainings, and make sure learnings show up in day-to-day customer work

  • Maintain and evolve career development guidelines, skill frameworks, and organizational design across all CS levels and functions

  • Own projects that carry the Leapsome culture across GTM teams and locations

  • Manage stakeholders across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Ops to align on learning priorities, and jump in on Sales enablement where it moves the needle

Your Profile

You don't need to tick every box. If most of this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years in enablement, L&D, CS, Sales, or a mix. What matters is that you've helped commercial teams get better at their jobs

  • A hands-on generalist: as comfortable facilitating a workshop as you are joining a client call, learning the product inside out, and coaching someone on how they ran the conversation

  • You design learning experiences around the people using them, and you communicate clearly at every level

  • Strong end-to-end ownership: you scope, design, execute, and maintain your projects rather than handing them off halfway

  • You work with AI tools daily and enjoy redesigning workflows around them, whether that's agent-supported onboarding or turning customer call insights into training content. Comfort with ops and data is part of that

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: impact-driven, agile, and unfazed when priorities shift

  • Fluent written and verbal English. German is a plus

  • Bonus points for HR tech or HR field experience, a solid grasp of the SaaS CS lifecycle, or account management and sales skills of your own.

Benefits

  • Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform.

  • Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace.

  • Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth.

  • Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network.

  • Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical.

  • Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness.

  • Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

  • Impact: Join a fast-growing HR platform trusted by more than 2,000 companies worldwide: you'll help shape how companies run HR and grow their people in one connected system.

  • Culture: A diverse, international team that values open feedback and celebrates wins, big and small.

  • Sponsored lunch: Lunch is on us every Tuesday and Thursday.

  • Work from anywhere: Work from a different location for up to 2 months a year.

  • Monthly team activities: Join Feierabend, a monthly budget to get-together in Berlin — hosted by employees, for employees.

This role is based in Berlin and the salary range for this position is dependent on the level in which we recruit this role:

Senior: €50,000 - €80,000 + Bonus + Equity.
Lead: €80,000 - €100,000 + Bonus + Equity.

View our full compensation framework here.

Leapsome aims to pay generously and fairly. If the listed range isn’t working for your situation, please tell us early in the process, we’d rather have that conversation than lose a great candidate over a number we may be able to address.

If your role or skillset isn’t covered in our compensation framework, it’s likely because we haven’t hired enough in that area yet. We’ll build a data-backed range before we make you an offer, and we’ll share our thinking with you as early as we can.

This note is published for transparency. It reflects our compensation philosophy as of June 2026 and describes our general global approach — it is not a contract, offer, or entitlement to any salary, increase, or bonus, and may change at any time. Individual compensation is always governed solely by your written employment agreement and applicable local law.



Leapsome’s values

We stay true to our values in everything we do at Leapsome. 

  • Impact is everything — We aim high, focus on the outcomes that matter and say no to the rest.

  • Speed is our advantage — We move fast with intent — simplifying, automating, and learning as we go.

  • Owners without egos — We trust owners and expect excellence in return. We take responsibility individually, support each other, and win as a team.

  • Candid is kind — We speak up early and respectfully. We assume good intent, stay curious, and care about each other’s growth.

Excited to be part of Leapsome? 😊

Just send us your CV. You won't need to input any information already mentioned on your CV later on - promise! 🤙

A cover letter isn’t necessary, but we’d really appreciate a brief answer to these questions: Why Leapsome? Why you?

We look forward to getting to know you!

You can find more about what our colleagues think about working at Leapsome here 👉 ✨✨✨ Glassdoor ✨✨✨ Kununu✨✨✨

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Help us make work fulfilling for everyone!

At Leapsome, we want work to be the best it can be for everyone. We help companies create environments where people can achieve shared goals, build authentic relationships, learn, and grow together.

Put simply; our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone. And we know how to get there. But we can only do this by “walking our talk” and building a diverse and inclusive company where people — not just the business — thrive.

jobs.title: Founding Product Success Manager, Head of CS Track
jobs.description:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

As our Founding Product Success Manager, you will sit between our customers and product team. You will own customer success after the initial sale while also playing a hands-on role in shaping and improving the product.

This is not a traditional Customer Success role. You will work directly with customers, understand their problems in depth, and work with our engineers to turn those problems into product improvements.

  • Own the customer relationship after the initial sale, from onboarding through successful adoption and long-term partnership

  • Build strong relationships with users, champions, and senior stakeholders at large Mittelstand companies and Tier-1 enterprises in the DACH region and beyond

  • Spend significant time with customers to understand their workflows, problems, and product needs

  • Drive product adoption across customer teams and help users integrate BoWatt into their day-to-day engineering processes

  • Ensure customers get measurable value from BoWatt by regularly reviewing progress, identifying blockers, and developing practical solutions

  • Run operative product management for customer-driven improvements: understand problems, define requirements, create and prioritize tickets, and work closely with engineering through implementation

  • Test new features with customers, collect feedback, and iterate together with the product and engineering teams

  • Own customer-facing software incidents and bugs end-to-end, from initial investigation and reproduction through prioritization and resolution with engineering

  • Identify opportunities to expand BoWatt within existing customers across additional teams, use cases, and business units

  • Bring structured customer feedback into the product team and help shape our product roadmap

  • Build and improve our processes for onboarding, adoption, customer feedback, product discovery, and customer success

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt's software, customers, and target industries

During your first 6 months, you will work closely with our CPO and product team to develop the product, industry, and customer knowledge needed to gradually take ownership of increasingly complex customers and product initiatives.

You

  • You genuinely enjoy working with customers and building strong, long-term relationships

  • You enjoy getting into the details of customer problems and figuring out how the product can solve them

  • You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point with both technical users and senior stakeholders

  • You are highly structured and take ownership of driving projects and customer initiatives to completion

  • You can understand complex customer challenges and turn them into clear, practical solutions and product requirements

  • You are proactive: you identify risks and opportunities early rather than waiting for customers to raise them

  • You are comfortable working with technical B2B products and are curious about how engineering and manufacturing teams operate

  • You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing bugs, features, priorities, and trade-offs

  • You want to grow into a domain expert across our software, customers, and industry

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and willing to go the extra mile to make customers successful

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in Customer Success, Product Management, Account Management, Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing B2B software role

  • Alternatively, experience in a technical customer-facing role at an industrial manufacturer, engineering company, or technology business

  • Experience onboarding customers, managing ongoing customer relationships, and driving product adoption

  • Experience translating customer problems and feedback into clear product requirements is a strong advantage

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and initiatives in parallel

  • Comfortable working with CRM, product management, and customer success tools

  • Ability to understand technical products and communicate effectively with both technical users and business stakeholders

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Manufacturing, engineering, product management, and/or startup experience is a bonus

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 vacation days per year, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • Significant ownership from day one

  • Direct exposure to customers, product, and engineering

  • The opportunity to help define how Product Success works at BoWatt as we scale

Interview process

  1. 30-minute screening call — Nat or Malte

  2. 60-minute interview — CPO, CEO

  3. 60-minute culture fit interview — CEO + CPO

  4. Offer and reference checks

We aim to complete the entire interview process within 14 days.

Your job isn't to be the fastest individual coder in the room; it is to amplify the entire squad through AI. Working alongside the Value Stream Lead and the squad's Technical Authority, you will provide the delivery structure, quality standards, and agentic development environment the team can trust. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Empower every employee.

Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen.

Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

 

Stellenausschreibung

KI-Orchestrierung steht im Zentrum der Zukunft von Flip. Flip Fusion, ein Multi-Agenten-System zur Code-Generierung, bildet das Herzstück unseres neuesten Produkts. Auch das Ask AI Agent Gateway und die Automatisierung durch Flip Flows laufen auf Fähigkeiten, die unsere KI-Engineers entwickeln und pflegen.

Als Lead AI Engineer übernimmst du die KI-Disziplin: Du verantwortest das Wie, also Architektur, Standards und technische Ausrichtung, über alle drei Bereiche hinweg, führst und entwickelst ein Team von drei AI-Engineers weiter und bleibst dabei hands-on an den anspruchsvollsten Problemen.

Was dich erwartet

  • KI-Architektur verantworten: Definiere eine kohärente KI-Architektur und einheitliche Standards für Flip Fusion, das Ask AI Agent Gateway und Flip Flows, und stimme sie aufeinander ab.

  • Die größte Herausforderung annehmen: Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die für konkrete Anwendungsfälle gebaut sind, aber generisch genug bleiben, um unterschiedliche Kund:innen zu bedienen, immer im Spannungsfeld zwischen hohen Ansprüchen, Machbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz.

  • Die Disziplin führen und weiterentwickeln: Übernimm die disziplinarische Führung für drei KI-Engineers und hilf ihnen dabei, sich zu Engineers zu entwickeln, die den technischen Maßstab selbst setzen.

  • Hands-on bleiben: Rund 70 Prozent deiner Zeit verbringst du im Code, an den Problemen, bei denen dein Urteilsvermögen am meisten zählt. Der Rest entfällt auf technische und disziplinarische Führung.

  • Produktübergreifend Einfluss nehmen: Setze Architekturentscheidungen mit den Product Managern und Engineering Leads um, die die Roadmaps verantworten, die nicht in deinem Bereich liegen, und überzeuge dabei durch das bessere Argument statt durch Weisung.

  • Mit unserem Stack arbeiten: Python, pydantic-ai für Orchestrierung, Qdrant für Vektorsuche, Azure AI für Modelle, deployed auf Kubernetes in ein überwiegend JVM-basiertes (Kotlin, Micronaut) und Go-Backend.

  • Eine junge Disziplin mitgestalten: KI-Engineering ist bei Flip so neu, dass es enormen Gestaltungsspielraum gibt und noch kein festes Playbook existiert.

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen einen Engineer mit einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament und echter Praxiserfahrung mit agentenbasierten Systemen in Produktion, der eine Disziplin führen möchte, statt nur an einer Codebase zu arbeiten. Wenn dich die Rolle reizt, du aber nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Must-haves:

  • 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz auf Senior- oder Staff-Level, aufbauend auf einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament (Backend, Platform oder Full-Stack).

  • Praxiserfahrung im Design, Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver LLM-basierter Systeme: RAG, Tool Calling und MCP, Orchestrierung und Evals. Keine Prototypen, sondern Systeme, mit denen du auch nach dem Go-live gelebt hast.

  • Erfahrung mit Multi-Agenten-Orchestrierung, die besonders stark gewichtet wird. Das ist der Kern dessen, was du architektonisch verantworten würdest.

  • Nachgewiesene technische Führungserfahrung: Architekturverantwortung, Tech-Lead-Verantwortung, RFCs, Design Reviews oder das Setzen von Standards für ein Team.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, technische Arbeit voranzubringen, die nicht in deinem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich liegt: Du gewinnst Architekturdiskussionen durch Überzeugungskraft und Glaubwürdigkeit und bist es gewohnt, recht zu haben, ohne die Entscheidungsgewalt zu haben.

  • Nachweise dafür, dass du Menschen weiterentwickelst: Coaching oder Mentoring von Engineers hin zu stärkeren Engineers, statt ihnen die Arbeit abzunehmen.

  • Ein klares, ausdrückliches Bekenntnis zu disziplinarischer Führung. Diese Rolle umfasst die Führung von drei Engineers, und das ist nicht der Teil, den du nur in Kauf nimmst, um den technischen Scope zu bekommen.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (C1).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Formale Erfahrung in der Personalführung: disziplinarische Führung, Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche, Recruiting. Starke Mentoring-Erfahrung zählt genauso viel.

  • Erfahrung in der teamübergreifenden Führung einer Disziplin oder eines Fachbereichs in einer Matrixorganisation.

  • Produkterfahrung im großen Maßstab: Frontline / Deskless Worker, High-Volume-B2B-SaaS oder Vergleichbares.

  • Erfahrung im Kosten-, Latenz- und Zuverlässigkeits-Engineering für LLM-Systeme: Guardrails, Fallbacks, Evaluation Harnesses.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf beliebigem Niveau. In Teilen des Unternehmens hilfreich, für diese Rolle aber nie Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir dir bieten

  • Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an.

  • Erfolge feiern: Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du gestaltest Flip aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen.

  • Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen.

Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wird im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. Bei Flip sind alle willkommen ganz egal, welches Geschlecht du hast oder wie alt du bist. Sexuelle Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung und Behinderungen spielen keine Rolle. Das Wichtigste ist, dass DU zu uns passt!

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Empower every employee.

Flip is the leading AI-powered employee experience platform for frontline workers. We're transforming how people do their jobs across the industries that keep the world running: retail, manufacturing, and logistics. One app. One touch. Everything they need.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

AI orchestration is at the centre of where Flip is going. Fusion, a multi-agent code-generation system sits at the core of our newest product, and our Ask AI agent gateway and Flip Flows automation both run on capabilities our AI engineers build and maintain.

As Lead AI Engineer you take over the AI discipline: you own the how (architecture, standards, technical direction) across all three surfaces, you lead and grow a team of three AI engineers, and you stay hands-on where the problems are hardest.

What you can expect

  • Own the AI architecture: Define and align a coherent AI architecture and set of standards across Flip Fusion, Ask AI agent gateway, and Flip Flows.

  • Tackle the hardest challenge: Multi-agent systems, built to specific purposes, generalizable enough for diverse customers, balancing high expectations with feasibility, reliability and cost effectiveness.

  • Lead and grow the discipline: Take over people leadership for three AI engineers and help them level up into engineers who set the technical bar themselves.

  • Stay hands-on: Roughly 70 percent of your time stays in the code, on the problems where your judgment matters most. The rest is technical and people leadership.

  • Influence across products: Land architecture decisions with the product managers and engineering leads who own the roadmaps you don't, by making the better argument rather than by mandate.

  • Work with our stack: Python, pydantic-ai for orchestration, qdrant for vector search, Azure AI for models, deployed on Kubernetes into a mostly JVM-based (Kotlin, Micronaut) and Go backend.

  • Shape a young discipline: AI engineering at Flip is new enough that there is enormous design space and no inherited playbook.

What you bring to the table

We're looking for an engineer with a software engineering foundation and real production depth in agentic systems, who wants to lead a discipline rather than just work a codebase. If you're excited about the role but don't tick every box, we still want to hear from you.

Must-haves:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a senior or staff-level track record, built on a software engineering foundation (backend, platform, or full-stack)

  • Hands-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM-powered systems in production: RAG, tool calling and MCP, orchestration, and evals. Not prototypes, systems you lived with after go-live.

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration, weighted heavily. This is the core of what you would be architecting.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: architecture ownership, tech lead responsibility, RFCs, design reviews, or setting standards for a team.

  • Proven ability to move technical work you don't own: you win architecture arguments through persuasion and credibility, and you're comfortable being right without being in charge.

  • Evidence that you grow people: coaching or mentoring engineers into stronger engineers rather than absorbing the work yourself.

  • A clear, explicit commitment to people leadership. This role includes managing three engineers and that is not the part you tolerate to get the technical scope.

  • Strong communication skills and business-fluent English (C1).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Formal people-management experience: line management, performance and development conversations, hiring. Strong mentoring evidence counts just as much.

  • Experience leading a discipline or craft across teams in a matrix organisation.

  • Product context at scale: frontline or deskless workforces, high-volume B2B SaaS, or comparable.

  • Cost, latency and reliability engineering for LLM systems: guardrails, fallbacks, evaluation harnesses.

  • German at any level. Useful in parts of the company, never required for this role.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

Wir fördern vom ersten Tag an Deine berufliche und private Weiterentwicklung und bieten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle sowie mobiles Arbeiten.   • Du übernimmst die aktive Neukundenakquise von mittelständischen und großen Unternehmen

  • Du erkennst Marktpotenziale, Branchen und Entscheidungsträger und nutzt sie gezielt

Qualifikation

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive | Germany
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team shaping the future of global communication

At DeepL, we are on an exciting mission to eliminate language barriers worldwide through AI. As we scale, our Sales team serves as the ultimate driver of our global reach and customer engagement.

Germany is our single largest and most strategic market globally—making this role a pivotal, high-visibility opportunity to shape our growth story. You will join an inclusive, highly collaborative environment where sales partners seamlessly with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to deliver transformational value to leading organizations.

How you will drive impact

  • Lead Strategic Growth in Germany: Cultivate deep relationships within our key existing business while identifying opportunities to win new top-tier enterprise clients across the region.

  • Deliver Transformational AI Solutions: Guide enterprise leaders beyond transactional product use, helping them adopt game-changing innovations like our real-time voice-to-voice lounge to transform their business operations.

  • Manage Enterprise Sales Cycles: Own the end-to-end journey for high-value prospects, from qualification to close, ensuring a consultative approach aligned with client goals.

  • Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with our international, welcoming SDR and Marketing teams to build pipeline and deliver custom solutions tailored to complex business needs.

  • Map Strategic Value: Track and forecast customer insights, purchase timeframes, and emerging use cases to ensure our enterprise partners achieve long-term success.

What will set you up for success

  • Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Proven track record in complex sales cycles within the DACH region. Industry experience in Finance, High Tech, or Manufacturing is strongly preferred.

  • Account Expansion & New Business: Experience both growing existing large enterprise accounts and introducing emerging technology to new logos.

  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong ability to lead, orchestrate, and align internal cross-functional partners to solve big challenges.

  • Adaptability & Drive: Comfort navigating dynamic, fast-scaling environments with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

  • Language Proficiency: fluency in German and English.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Risk (UK)
jobs.description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner - EMEA
jobs.description:
We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Our People Partners are embedded partners to leaders and teams, not a service desk. We're looking for a Senior People Partner to own the people agenda across EMEA. Based in London and reporting to the Head of People Enablement & Operations, you'll hold primary responsibility for the UK & Ireland alongside our growing footprint in France and Germany, plus our teams in South Africa and the UAE. As Heidi expands, your remit expands with it.

This is a broad regional role built on judgment, coaching, influence and business impact. You'll partner with leaders on performance, talent, organizational design, leadership capability and team effectiveness, and you'll help us navigate the people implications of scaling into new markets through a mix of local entities and Employer of Record arrangements. You won't need to be an employment lawyer in every jurisdiction, but you'll know where the risk sits and when to bring in specialist help. We build excellent teams without unnecessary layers, process or bureaucracy: strong people practice should increase clarity and performance, not slow teams down.

We're also actively working out what the People function looks like inside an AI-native company, where administrative work gets absorbed by tooling and the real value-add moves higher. This role is for someone already thinking that way.

What you'll do

  • Own People partnership across EMEA, becoming the trusted partner to leaders and teams in the UK & Ireland, Europe, South Africa and the UAE

  • Translate regional business priorities, growth plans and talent needs into a clear set of people priorities

  • Coach managers through performance, feedback, accountability and complex employee matters, building their confidence rather than their dependency on you

  • Challenge leaders directly and honestly to raise performance, leadership capability and team effectiveness

  • Partner on organizational design, workforce planning, team structure and succession as the region scales, spotting capability and talent gaps before they bite

  • Bring clear, balanced judgment to performance calibration, talent reviews, promotions and reward decisions, and help leaders stretch and retain our strongest people

  • Work with People Operations and external partners to navigate employment requirements across multiple jurisdictions, including EOR-employed teams, so our people approach scales as our footprint does

  • Use people data and business context to surface trends, risks and opportunities, and simplify, automate and apply AI to strip out low-value admin

If we'd worked together the last 6 weeks

  • You'd have coached a manager through a difficult performance conversation they'd been avoiding, and they'd have run the second one without you

  • You'd have sat in calibration with a leadership team and changed a rating that didn't hold up to the evidence

  • You'd have worked out how we support a new team hired through an EOR in a market we'd never employed in before, and written down the approach so the next market is faster

  • You'd have flagged a capability gap in a scaling team eight weeks before it became a hiring emergency

  • You'd have killed a process the region didn't need and replaced it with something a manager can actually run

What you'll need

  • 5+ years partnering senior leaders in fast-growing, high-accountability environments, across multiple countries or jurisdictions, though we care more about what you've built than years on the clock

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone's day

  • Strong talent judgment. You spot performance risk and high-potential talent early, and you don't reach for a rigid playbook to do it

  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid international growth. You take complex problems from identification to resolution without waiting for everything to be defined

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects

  • You default to building over requesting

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.

Hivebuy is a Berlin-based B2B procurement SaaS transforming how companies manage purchasing, approvals, orders, invoices, budgets and suppliers.

Our core stack includes Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Elasticsearch, Vue 3, TypeScript and AWS. We run our services on ECS Fargate, manage infrastructure with Terraform, and use Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry and CloudWatch to understand what’s happening in production.

AI coding agents are a normal part of how we develop software. We believe they make strong engineers significantly more effective, but they also make judgment, verification and ownership more important, not less.

Tasks

  • Own features end-to-end. Understand the problem, challenge requirements when necessary, design the solution, implement it, test it, deploy it and verify that it actually works in production.

  • Work across the stack when necessary, implementing and debugging functionality in our Vue 3 + TypeScriptfrontend.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems such as ERP/accounting platforms, authentication providers, billing systems, Slack and Microsoft Teams.
  • Work on our growing AI-powered product features and help us integrate LLMs responsibly into production workflows.

  • Strong professional experience building and operating production systems with Python and Django, ideally Django REST Framework.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL, including data modelling, migrations, query performance, indexing and diagnosing database-related production issues.
  • Experience designing and evolving asynchronous and distributed workloads, ideally with Celery and Redis, including retries, idempotency, failure handling and long-running tasks.

  • Strong experience with production observability. You know how to use metrics, logs, error tracking and profiling to understand system behaviour and find root causes instead of guessing.
  • Experience identifying and solving performance and scalability problems across applications, databases, background workers and infrastructure.
  • Experience working with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure and a good understanding of how applications actually run in production.

  • Strong engineering judgment. You can distinguish between something that needs architectural work, something that needs a small pragmatic fix and something that should not be built at all.
  • You proactively identify technical problems and improvements instead of waiting for them to become tickets.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
Founding Implementation Lead (NHS)
jobs.description:
About Heim

Community nursing is one of the most complex operational environments in healthcare, and one of the least well equipped for it. A caseload scattered across an entire geography. Patients in high-rises, care homes, rural cottages, living rooms. Nurses driving between them with a bag, a list that is sometimes still on paper, and no way to signal when the day has stopped being deliverable. Above them, operational leaders trying to understand what is happening in the field from a spreadsheet that was out of date before it was opened.

That is what we are changing at Heim.

We believe care belongs in the home, and that the shift away from hospital-based care has already started. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by giving the community workforce technology that makes their days simpler, more manageable and more rewarding. We have built an AI-native ecosystem that handles the scheduling and logistics of community care, and we are working through every non-clinical touchpoint until the admin is gone.

To date, our technology has powered a network of 400+ practitioners to deliver around 40,000 appointments, and our algorithms have been shown to give back up to a third of the working day for clinical care. We are growing fast across the NHS and social care, where services are being asked to hit productivity targets using the tools they already have. We give community teams workforce intelligence through Heim Insights, alongside the most capable suite of AI-native productivity tools built specifically for care outside hospital.

The role

As our founding Implementation Lead, you will build Heim's Delivery function while running the deployments that function exists to support.

You will own large-scale deployments of Heim software inside the NHS and social care. These are the deployments the product learns from and long-term partnerships are built on. In your first two, your work will shape the working day of more than 800 nurses delivering close to a million patient contacts a year.

Delivering a fixed scope on time is the floor. The job is to earn real engagement from clinical and operational teams, turn that engagement into adoption that holds after you leave the room, and route everything you learn back into the product.

A partner said to us recently, "we can't wait for everyone to be ready, they might never be." Readiness follows change rather than preceding it. People get comfortable with something new by trying it, watching it work, and finding that the thing they were worried about was manageable. Getting teams to that point is the craft of this role.

You will lead deployments end to end, from mobilisation and structured discovery through to go-live of dashboards, the Companion App and AI-assisted productivity features, while standing up the playbooks, processes and frameworks that make the next deployment, and the ten after it, considerably better.

What you'll do

Lead NHS deployments end to end

  • Own the full implementation lifecycle for each NHS partner, from contract mobilisation and governance kick-off through structured discovery, go-live, and into embedded business-as-usual use.

  • Run phased, multi-team rollouts to plan: coordinating activities, timelines, dependencies and resources across cohorts, keeping milestones on track and briefing the right people at the right moment.

  • Own the DPIA support, data flow sign-off and information governance steps that gate NHS go-live, working alongside our Clinical Safety Officer and the Trust's governance leads.

  • Spot the risks and blockers early, whether operational, clinical, technical or political, and have the mitigation ready before it reaches the timeline or the relationship.

Earn engagement and adoption inside the Trust

  • Be the face of Heim to the partner: the person who knows the service, knows the product, and is trusted by both the ward and the board.

  • Build relationships at every level, from frontline staff and shift coordinators, to team leads and super-users, to the COO, Divisional Director and project sponsor. You will run the weekly check-ins and the monthly leadership reviews that keep a programme moving.

  • Get to real adoption. Coach teams through new ways of working, watch the usage data, and step in early where engagement dips or a team gets stuck.

  • Arm our champions inside the Trust to make the internal case for wider rollout, translating impact for the people who control budget, sequencing and expansion.

Run the co-design loop between the NHS and product

  • Treat every deployment as live co-design. Surface how community teams actually work, where the product fits, and where it needs to bend to clinical and operational reality.

  • Be the high-fidelity channel between the front line and our Product and Engineering teams, bringing back structured, prioritised feedback that shapes the roadmap.

  • Manage expectations with care where capability is still being built or is pending regulatory approval such as MDR, keeping partners confident and well informed without over-promising.

Build the Implementation function

  • Create the playbooks, deployment frameworks, governance packs, onboarding materials and health frameworks that make NHS implementation repeatable.

  • Codify what works, so each deployment is faster, smoother and lower-risk than the last. This is what gets us to six live Trusts in the next 9 to 12 months.

  • Set the standard as the function grows, and mentor the implementation hires who follow you.


Who you are

You have 4 to 6 years leading complex implementation, deployment or transformation work, from a consulting or start-up background. You have been an engagement, deployment or implementation lead already and have delivered software into healthcare providers, ideally the NHS, and you know what it takes to get clinical teams to genuinely adopt something new. You are comfortable writing your own playbook and turning what you learn into a repeatable engine as we sign more partners.

Beyond that:

  • A builder. You can create process, structure and documentation from scratch while simultaneously running a live, high-stakes programme.

  • A relationship builder and communicator. You enjoy the human side of this work: earning trust, following up, making partners feel looked after. You can hold a room of senior NHS stakeholders, sit alongside frontline staff, and turn complexity into a crisp written narrative.

  • Fluent in the NHS and social care context. You understand clinical safety and information governance in practice (DCB0129, DTAC, DPIA, MDR), and the real difficulty of adopting technology in a stretched public system.

  • Data literate and insight-led. You can interrogate operational and clinical data, understand what sits behind the numbers, and turn analysis into a clear story that helps partners decide and demonstrate impact.

  • Calm under uncertainty. The product is evolving, partners are co-designing it with us, priorities shift. You bring order to that for everyone around you.

  • Commercially aware. You understand that adoption is what turns a contract into a renewal and a reference, and you act on it without being asked.

  • AI fluent. You use AI tools daily, you keep pace with how fast they are moving, and you are excited to put genuinely new capability into the front line of care.

  • Meticulous. An exceptional eye for detail in planning, execution and quality.

Above all, you care about this. The systemic shift of healthcare into the home is happening, and the difference between a pilot and a partnership is usually the person leading it.

Practical requirements

  • You have the right to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • A full UK driving licence is preferred. This role spends real time on partner sites, often in services that cover a wide geography.

  • We are looking for an immediate start ideally, in September or October. Please tell us your availability in your application.

What we offer

  • Salary of £55,000 to £70,000 depending on experience, with eligibility for equity options at the end of your probation period and a performance based bonus.

  • 33 days' holiday (25 days plus 8 bank holidays).

  • An extra day off for your birthday, or the nearest weekday.

  • Regular socials, team trips, meals and an annual company retreat.

  • Direct ownership of the most important deployments in the company, working closely with our founders and the team building the product.

  • Hybrid working from our Shoreditch office, with regular travel to NHS partner sites.

How to apply

  • This role is urgent, so we are moving quickly. Please include your availability to start.

  • Application. Send us your profile, tell us why you are a great fit for this role, and confirm when you could start.

  • Screening. CV screening video call.

  • Case study. In-person presentation, so we can see how you think, communicate and interact.

  • Culture fit. In-person conversation with a founder and members of the team.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (EMEA FSP 2)
jobs.description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview 

Magnet Forensics is seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business growth across the  European (excluding United Kingdom and Ireland) forensic service provider market (EMEA FSP 2)
 
This role is focused on building pipeline, acquiring strategic new enterprise customers, and expanding adoption across corporate and private-sector organisations. The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven ability to independently develop territory strategy, create opportunities, and own complex enterprise sales cycles end-to-end using a MEDDPICC-driven sales approach, in addition to handling high volumes of smaller, transactional type sales which involve a rapidly moving sales cycle.
 
As a key member of Magnet Forensics’ EMEA team, you will operate with significant ownership of the EMEA FSP 2 region, working closely with partners located across Europe, marketing, dedicated sales development representative (SDR), sales engineering, and leadership to establish and scale market presence.
 

This role is best suited to candidates motivated by long-term territory development and market ownership rather than short-term account management or inherited revenue.

Candidate must reside in Germany

What You’ll Do

Sales Execution & Territory Ownership

  • Develop and execute a territory plan focused on pipeline creation, new logo acquisition, and predictable revenue growth across the European forensic service provider market.
  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation and close.
  • Maintain strong pipeline coverage aligned to quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Engage executive stakeholders and decision makers within enterprise organizations.

    • MEDDPICC Deal Execution

    • Apply MEDDPICC rigorously to qualify opportunities, access economic buyers, build champions, multithread, and drive forecast accuracy.
    • Navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments and long sales cycles.
    • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and forecasting practices.

      • Market Expansion

      • Drive market penetration through outbound prospecting, executive networking, and partner collaboration.
      • Acquire new enterprise logos while expanding strategic existing accounts.
      • Identify and develop growth opportunities within key verticals and regulated industries.

        • Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

      • Work closely with regional partners and resellers to generate pipeline and execute joint sales strategies.
      • Enable partners through joint account planning, opportunity alignment, and customer engagement activities.

        • Marketing & Industry Engagement

        • Collaborate with marketing to support regional campaigns, events, and demand generation initiatives. This will sometimes involve collaborating with partners.
        • Represent Magnet Forensics at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements across Europe.

          • Customer Engagement

          • Act as a trusted advisor to customers by understanding investigative, cybersecurity, and digital forensics challenges.
          • Deliver solution-led sales engagements aligned to customer outcomes and business value.

What We’re Looking For
  • 4+ years of enterprise sales experience within SaaS, Cybersecurity, DFIR, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and executive networking.
  • Experience managing both complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and shorter sales cycles and executive with efficiency and precision.
  • Strong experience applying MEDDPICC (or equivalent) sales methodology.
  • Experience working with both direct and partner-led sales models.
  • Self-starter with the ability to operate independently in a developing region.
  • Comfortable working across international teams and time zones.
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Highly organized with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management practices. Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to territory growth.
  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
  • Meticulous with a strong eye for administrative detail – certain products sold by the EMEA FSP team have a heavily involved approval process where this trait is a must.
    •  

    What Success Looks Like in This Role
  • Build and develop a sustainable enterprise pipeline across the European forensic service provider market through proactive prospecting, partner engagement, and executive relationship development.
  • Establish Magnet Forensics as a trusted investigative technology partner within strategic enterprise accounts.Consistently progress opportunities through structured discovery, value alignment, and MEDDPICC-driven execution.Deliver predictable revenue performance while contributing to long-term regional market growth.

    • Compensation & Benefits 

    The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you.  If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable).
     

    €94,100 – €134,000 (EUR) a year

    Salary range (min - max)
     

    Position Type: Current Vacancy 

     


    Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: 
     
    - Generous time off policies 
    - Competitive compensation 
    - Volunteer opportunities  
    - Reward and recognition programs   
    - Employee committees & resource groups  
     
    Indicators of Success
     
    We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
     
    How We Work
     
    At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
     
    We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
     
    The Most Important Thing
     
    We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:
     
    CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.
    OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.
    DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.
    EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
     
    Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce.
