jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Enablement Engineering team and help us build a world-class data platform. Superhuman's success depends on its ability to efficiently ingest over 60 to 70 billion daily events while using our systems to improve our product. This role presents a unique opportunity to experience all aspects of building complex software systems, including contributing to the strategy, defining the architecture, and developing and shipping to production.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. You can hear more from our team on our technical blog.

Your Impact

As a Data Engineer on the Data Enablement Engineering team, you will shape the architecture and technical strategy of our data platform, ensuring scalability, security, and efficiency across data engineering systems. You will design and lead the implementation of robust, scalable, and reliable systems that handle large volumes of data, empowering both product features and data-driven decision-making across the company. Your work will span areas such as real-time & ETL data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data lakes, and back-end services.

This role requires you to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including back-end engineers, Analytics engineering, Data Science engineering, and machine learning teams, to drive initiatives that support various business outcomes. As a senior IC, you will also mentor engineers and help set the strategic direction for the platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and lead the development of large-scale systems for data pipelines, data lakes that handle billions of daily events.

  • Design and implement solutions that ensure data is available, secure, and scalable across the platform, enabling real-time and batch processing.

  • Make high-level architectural decisions about system design, technology choices, and platform evolution, ensuring scalability and long-term sustainability.

  • Collaborate with key stakeholders, such as product teams, data engineers, back-end developers, and ML engineers, to build tools & frameworks that power analytics, product features, and data-driven workflows.

  • Work with business stakeholders such as Analytics Eng, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Product teams to build high-impact data products enabling business-critical features, research, and experimentation with a focus on efficiency and alignment

  • Collaborate with Leadership in devising the charter and technical roadmaps

  • Mentor engineers across back-end infrastructure and data engineering disciplines, fostering a culture of collaboration and technical excellence.

Qualifications

  • Has experience in large-scale distributed computing systems, with expertise in both data engineering and data modeling.

  • Has experience managing live production environments, including high-load systems or data-intensive workflows, with a focus on uptime and reliability.

  • Expert in SQL and proficient in technologies like Spark, Kafka, Terraform, and in at least one programming language commonly used for data engineering (e.g., Python, Scala, or Java).

  • Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT design patterns, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Dagster), and data quality frameworks.

  • Ability to design scalable, secure, and maintainable data models and architectures, and understanding of data governance, privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).

  • Hands-on experience with modern data storage technologies (e.g., Delta Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

  • Is a strategic thinker, able to evaluate whether to build internally or leverage third-party solutions, ensuring the right balance between speed, scalability, and long-term viability.

  • Is an excellent communicator and collaborator, able to work across diverse teams and stakeholders, translates business needs into robust data solutions, and ensures alignment on technical goals.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal to zero guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We hire people we trust, and we give team members autonomy to do their best work. We also support professional development with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. We have a highly collaborative culture. We also take time to celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific events and programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package that includes superior health care. We also offer ample and defined time off, catered lunches, gym and recreation stipends, admission discounts, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

Compensation range: €91,000–€125,000

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are seeking a talented Thermal Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development of our future projects. As a Thermal Systems Engineer, you will oversee the thermal architecture, sizing and analysis of a variety of new projects. You will work closely with our mechanical, CAD, and system engineers to assess feasibility and preliminary sizing of the thermal systems of our future vehicles.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Thermal Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day your duties will include:

  • Designing conceptual and preliminary thermal control systems for new space systems, tailored to project maturity and goals

  • Providing technical solutions to optimise thermal management, in collaboration with other subsystems (propulsion, avionics, ECLSS…)

  • Perform preliminary thermal analyses to justify the design decisions

  • Effectively communicating and providing recommendations through analyses, reviews, documentation and presentation of technical data

  • Supporting spacecraft development from concept to operations, including feasibility studies, trade-off analyses, requirements review, system design, and documentation for major development milestones

  • Managing procurement, request for proposals, supplier evaluation and selection, testing and validation of thermal hardware

  • Providing operational analysis and support, including post-flight analyses

What We Would Love to See from You

In the role of Future Project Thermal Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Education: Master’s or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, Heat transfer and Fluid mechanics, or another related field.

  • Technical skills: Thermal analysis, Thermal management of typical spacecraft subsystems (structures, avionics, propulsion), and understanding of spacecraft thermal environments

  • Experience: Proven experience (3+ years) with (Active) Thermal Control System development and procurement, hands-on experience with Thermal Testing, including Thermal Cycling, Thermal Vacuum and Thermal Balance tests

  • Programming Skills: Proficiency with thermal software (Thermal Desktop, ESATAN), and in programming and data analysis (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C++).

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Feedback: Willingness to give proactive and mindful feedback across all company levels.

  • Mindset: Passion for advancing sustainability in the space industry and highly motivated to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding start-up environment.

  • Languages: Fluent in English.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

jobs.title: Senior Java Engineer (m/f/d) - Team Search
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven Senior Java Engineer to join our customer-facing Search team in our Demand Division. This team owns the first crucial step in the booking funnel and focuses on providing a fast and intuitive user experience to our customers in 40+ countries worldwide.

As a Search team, our goal is to simplify the user experience and provide enough information — without overwhelming the user — to help customers find their perfect trip easily. We achieve this by analyzing anonymous behavior data and conducting regular user research, ensuring we focus on good solutions for real user issues. Looking ahead, we aim to make even greater use of our big data to enhance the user experience with relevant statistics and insights at the right moment in the journey.

You'd join an autonomous, cross-functional squad — a Product Owner, backend and frontend engineers, plus data & UX partners and principal engineers who've built this engine at scale. Honest retros, short standups, real ownership from concept to production. We also invite you to be an active contributor to the Engineering Community and challenge the status quo at FlixTech!

About the Role

  • Be at the forefront of Flix's booking funnel, handling millions of search requests per day from Web, App, and external partners
  • Generate the inventory to allow customers to reach any place on our network (3,000+ destinations in 40+ countries!)
  • Apply your geekiness: have you ever wondered what to do with graph theory? This is the team for you!
  • Write SOLID, maintainable, flexible, testable, and scalable code
  • Design components and integrations within team scope, considering scalability, maintainability, and reliability
  • Lead adoption of better engineering practices and adapt workflows for team efficiency
  • Prioritise and plan tech debt pay-down with the team; drive strategies to reduce recurring debt
  • Ensure team code is observable and design monitoring strategies for new components
  • Support our CI/CD environment and produce a positive impact with each release
  • Support our agile, flexible, team-oriented development to bring the search product to the next level

About You

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or relevant industry experience
  • 7+ years of commercial experience as a Java Engineer
  • Strong experience with Java/JVM-based frameworks such as Micronaut or Spring Boot
  • Solution-oriented attitude with a focus on materializing the business vision through technical means
  • Experience with k8s and AWS
  • Experience with database management systems such as MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Solid experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka or others)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
  • Experience with Redis and Terraform
  • Familiarity with CI/CD best practices (unit and integration testing, GitLab CI)
  • Experience working with scalable systems handling large volumes of requests/data

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

jobs.title: Senior Commerce Consultant
Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's engineering team to help build and operate the services and pipelines the platform runs on.

ExTrac takes a continuously ingested, multi-source corpus and turns it into products analysts use to make decisions under time pressure. You will help build and run the backend microservices that make that possible: services and databases that expose curated data through APIs, run search and aggregation over large indices, hold application state, and keep the whole thing fast and correct as volume and customer count grow.

The work is broad by design. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own well-defined features and components end to end within a single system across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built.

What the job involves

Service design and delivery

  • Build and own features, components, and APIs end to end within a single system, taking responsibility for your work and its place within the overall architecture.

  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions, and take on more of the design work as you build context and scope.

  • Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions.

Production engineering

  • Develop Go and Python-based microservices to support data collection, processing, and querying, with guidance from senior engineers on more complex components.

  • Help hold services to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, and build the instrumentation to know when they are not meeting them.

  • Build and operate high-throughput data streaming pipelines and work on improving scalability, robustness, and latency.

  • Help optimise databases and index performance where it is the constraint on product behaviour.

Working with analysts, product, and other engineering teams

  • Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system.

  • Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon platform work.

  • Partner with the AI and frontend teams to deliver cross-functional features, working through the engineering, performance, and reliability problems that sit outside of their scope.

  • Contribute to the shared foundations other engineers depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, observability, and the environments their work runs in.

You should apply if

  • You have built and worked on production backend systems. You will spend your time working on Go and Python services, databases, and APIs, and you know the difference between something that works on a laptop and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost.

  • You can work independently on well-defined problems, and know when to flag ambiguity or ask for input rather than guessing. When the obvious approach fails, you look for another one before escalating.

  • You are happy to take the initiative in order to complete a task, whether that means learning a new skill, reaching out to stakeholders to clarify requirements, or suggesting an alternate approach.

  • You treat quality, security, and observability as engineering fundamentals rather than optional extras, and you flag technical debt rather than letting it accumulate silently.

  • You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you.

  • You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences.

Where this role can take you

  • Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means ownership over larger sections of the platform, more architectural say over how our services evolve, and more influence over which problems we take on.

  • Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means service design one month and pipeline or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one.

  • Progression based on impact. Progress by taking on bigger problems. What moves you to Senior here is the scope you can own end to end and the judgement you show when the answer isn't obvious, not time served.

Requirements

Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand.

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system.

  • Proficiency in building microservices using Go or Python, with the ability to pick up the other quickly.

  • Practical understanding of software engineering patterns.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable writing clear technical documentation and discussing requirements with colleagues from engineering and the wider team.

  • Interest across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, and security engineering.

  • An interest in how the product is actually used, and a willingness to take analyst feedback into requirements discussions rather than treating requirements as someone else's problem.

Desirable

  • Currently working with Go-based microservices.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch and/or PostgreSQL.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and with the CI/CD pipelines around them.

  • Experience with streaming or event-driven pipelines.

  • Experience with feature flags and trunk-based development. Features land close to weekly, and individual deploys go out several times a day across several projects.

  • Experience working in software for defence, government, or other compliance-constrained environments.

Interview Process

  • Initial Intro Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes

  • Technical Assessment - 1 hour

  • Competency-based Interview - 1 hour

  • Founder interview - 30 Minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend up to 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office.

ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. Senior Fullstack Engineer UK

Full-time /London (Engineering)

About Applied Intuition Defence

Applied Intuition UK is a software and infrastructure supplier that accelerates the deployment of next-generation autonomous capabilities to the warfighter across air, land, sea, and space. A subsidiary of Applied Intuition, we deliver dual-use solutions to national security customers that build upon several years of product development and experience from commercial autonomy programs. Based in London, our seasoned defence team hails from Palantir, Anduril, SpaceX, Google, Lockheed Martin, and the UK and US Armed Services. Learn more at appliedintuitiondefense.com.

About the role

You would be the first fullstack engineer we hire onto the UK team, joining software and autonomy engineers whose tools are already relied on across live programmes. As that portfolio grows, we are bringing in dedicated fullstack expertise to shape how the user-facing products we ship are designed and built. Every day is different: designing an interface around how a customer actually operates, building the services and APIs behind it, working with our design team so what we ship in London is coherent with everything else Applied Intuition builds, or taking what we learn on a programme and landing it in the products of the teams we work alongside.   • Get the improvements we identify on programmes into the products our other teams build, so what we learn in the field shapes the wider roadmap

  • Engineer security in from the first commit, and build software that holds up to the environments and the scrutiny our customers operate under

  • Help raise the bar for how user-facing software is built here, and build products people depend on and that you are proud of

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 5+ years of hands-on fullstack experience shipping and supporting production web applications

  • Deep expertise in React and TypeScript, or another modern front-end framework, and strong, well-founded opinions about building interfaces for data-heavy workflows

  • Adaptability across languages and comfort owning the whole stack; our products span TypeScript, Go and Python, and we care more about your judgement than your syntax

  • Experience working closely with designers and product managers, and a track record of getting your requirements into products you don't own

  • Command of application security, and experience developing in Docker and containerised environments on Linux

Travel Requirements:

  • General willingness to travel for company business between our offices, as well as to customer sites

Security Requirements:

  • Experience building or extending a design system used across more than one team

jobs.title: Founding Head of Product
jobs.description:
Mission

We are looking for a product leader who wants to play a foundational role in redefining how healthcare is accessed by patients.

We can get food, groceries and rides to our door, on-demand. Yet, accessing healthcare still means battling outdated systems, long waiting lists and travelling to overstretched clinical facilities with unpredictable experiences.

We know demand is rising, capacity in clinical settings is not coping, and patients' expectations are fundamentally different when it comes to managing their health. That is why Heim exists. To create the AI layer for the last mile of healthcare, that lets us make home the default place for patients to access care, at scale

Our proprietary algorithms and productivity tooling are already live inside our own 450+ practitioner network, and have powered tens of thousands of visits so far. NHS community teams are now pulling for our software faster than we can ship it. We’re hiring our first Head of Product to turn that pull into a category-defining company.

This is a founding, exec-level role. You will own and define Heim’s product roadmap — not execute someone else’s spec — working shoulder-to-shoulder with our founders, medical director and product engineers to decide what Heim becomes.

About us

We’re a team of technologists, clinicians and commercial leaders with a track record of success in launching, scaling and exiting ventures in cloud technology and healthcare.

Prior to Heim, James Monico and Kelly Klifa built Testing For All, scaling the not for profit diagnostics provider to become the go-to platform for Covid-testing during the pandemic and testing over 1m patients in <18 months. Prior to that, James Monico co-founded and scaled Cloudreach, before exiting to Blackstone in 2017. Dr Elle Clarke, Heim’s Medical Director is a fellow of the 2026 NHS Innovation Accelerator.

What you will own

  • Shape product direction, execution and standards to make Heim the go-to AI platform to help reach more patients, at home - working closely with our product engineers and commercial team.

  • Heim’s AI-native product strategy: how we ship agentic systems that behave safely, and how we structure product teams built around AI-native tooling.

  • Drive clarity and accountability across the organisation and help us keep up with fast growing demand for our software

  • Be the link between the frontline reality of community nursing and the software we ship — staying close enough to spot the next 10x improvement before clinicians can describe it.

  • You continuously raise the bar for our team, and you will have ultimate responsibility for quality and continuous improvement of our tech stack.


What you will bring

  • 6–8+ years in product or engineering leadership, ideally forged in startup or scale-up environments.

  • A track record of owning and shipping complex products end-to-end: from discovery through production — ideally in high-stakes domains.

  • Real technical depth: you can read and challenge a codebase, and engineers rate you as one of the best product partners they’ve worked with.

  • Native AI fluency: you’ve shipped agentic or conversational AI systems, and you’re obsessed with how they behave, fail and improve.

  • Extreme ownership and low ego, paired with the judgment to move fast where clinical safety matters.

  • A first-principles instinct — you’d rather find the simple answer than manage the complicated one.

Top Qualities We’re Looking For:

  • You believe that there is beauty in simplicity and will strive to drive back to first principles when working on complex customer problems

  • A critical mind that helps you guide your organisation to thoughtful and clear decision-making. Our curiosity and initiative are the two biggest inputs that empower us to talk to customers, evaluate tradeoffs, and dig into the data. We aim to continuously ask ourselves “Are we solving the most important customer problems right now? Are we doing so in ways that align with our overarching strategy?”

  • Ready to be challenged and thrive in an unstructured, fast moving environment

Qualifications & Experience

  • 6-8 years of experience working in engineering and/or product roles, including startup or scale up experience

  • Built products using nodejs frameworks, in cloud platforms with full CI/CD

  • Using AI to accelerate product velocity from prototype to production

  • Equally comfortable with high level strategy work and rolling up your sleeves to conduct primary research with key stakeholders

  • Work in a complex data domain such as healthcare, finance or crypto preferred

  • Ability to navigate and meaningfully contribute to a code base

  • Strong leadership skills

  • Degree in engineering or science or humanities if coupled with work experience learning coding and data analytics practices

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary, plus founding-team equity that reflects the seniority of this seat.

  • 33 days holiday (25 + 8 bank holidays), plus your birthday off.

  • Private health insurance and pension.

  • Quarterly company retreats and regular team socials.

jobs.title: Project Planner (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) -  Frankfurt/Berlin/Munich (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? 
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? 
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job? 
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? 
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on. 
____________________________________________________________
We are Laminar Projects!
 
If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.
 
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.)
We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)
 
The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)
 
This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. 
 
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)
 
Core values for a good life
 
A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
 
- Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself 
- Care about people – your relationship with others around you 
- Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team 
- Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world 
 
We enshrined our values in our vision:
 
We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
 
- Connects us with meaningful relationships 
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans 
- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 
 
By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
 
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
 
- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation 
- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society 
____________________________________________________________
The Role 
 
Purpose of the role 
 
You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise. 
 
Your team 
 
This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on:
 
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are 
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems 
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology 
 
More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors.
 
Your top three objectives 
 
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you 
 
Your top five responsibilities 
 
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially 
2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are 
3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively 
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved 
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well  
 
You must have:
 
- A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data
- Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach 
- Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them 
- Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact 
 
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 
 
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge 
- You like to be the smartest person in the room 
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback 
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
____________________________________________________________
Frequently Asked Questions 
 
What kinds of projects would I be working on?
It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) 
 
Who are our clients?
Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. 
 
Where would I be working?
One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. 
 
How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? 
You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. 
 
The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. 
 
____________________________________________________________
 
Benefits
 
The standard stuff: 
 
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance 
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft 
 
The life-changing stuff:
 
- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up
____________________________________________________________
 
Important! Applying properly
 
We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
 
- Why you want to join us 
- What you’ll bring to the team 
 
We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix.  
 
This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Composite Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Composite Engineer to support the development, verification, and qualification of primary and secondary composite structures for space applications.

The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in composite materials, structural mechanics, and verification methodologies, combined with a solid understanding of the complete lifecycle of structural hardware development. The role requires the ability to define robust technical solutions, assess structural integrity, support manufacturing activities, and contribute to the delivery of flight-quality composite structures.

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with a pragmatic mindset and understands how requirements, design, analysis, manufacturing, inspection, testing, and qualification activities contribute to the successful delivery of high-reliability hardware.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, verification, and qualification of composite structural hardware for space applications.

  • Define structural concepts and perform design trade-offs considering reliability, mass, manufacturability, schedule, and cost.

  • Develop technical specifications covering structural requirements, materials, manufacturing processes, inspection, and verification activities.

  • Support the selection of materials, manufacturing processes, laminate architectures, and structural interfaces.

  • Identify and assess critical failure modes throughout the product lifecycle and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented.

  • Support supplier management activities, including technical oversight of build-to-print and build-to-specification hardware.

  • Review supplier analyses, manufacturing documentation, inspection reports, test reports, and non-conformance dispositions.

  • Support anomaly investigations, root cause analyses, and corrective action implementation.

  • Interface with systems engineering, manufacturing, AIT, quality, procurement, and program teams.

  • Present technical recommendations and structural justifications during project reviews and decision boards.

  • Contribute to the development of robust, manufacturable, inspectable, and flightworthy structural solutions.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in structural analysis and mechanical justification of aerospace, space, or other high-performance composite structures.

  • Proven experience in the design, development, verification, and qualification of composite structures.

  • Strong knowledge of composite materials, manufacturing processes, structural mechanics, and damage tolerance principles.

  • Proficiency in finite element modelling and simulation methods for static, buckling, dynamic, thermo-mechanical, and joint analyses.

  • Proficiency in finite element analysis (FEA) software (Altair suite and Nastran are preferable).

  • Good understanding of composite design allowables, materials and process qualification, structural testing, and analysis-to-test correlation.

  • Experience with bolted and bonded joints, load introduction, and interface justification in composite structures.

  • Experience with CAD software (Siemens NX) is a plus,

  • Fluent in English. Knowledge of German, French or Italian is an asset.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • Strong engineering judgement, analytical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Ability to take ownership of complex technical topics and drive them to closure.

  • Proactive and pragmatic mindset, capable of balancing technical excellence, schedule constraints, and business objectives.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and external suppliers.

  • Ability to identify risks early, challenge assumptions, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Comfortable operating across design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, and qualification activities.

  • Demonstrates behaviors aligned with The Exploration Company values, including Mission, Integrity, Excellence, Vision and Teamwork.

  • Motivated to contribute to the development and delivery of reliable, flightworthy space hardware in a fast-paced and ambitious environment.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

jobs.description:
What is Leapsome?

Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams. Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.

Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone, and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own the creative engine behind our paid social growth. This role is for someone who lives and breathes creative. You'll lead the research, briefing, testing, and iteration that drives performance on Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and you'll think about every creative decision in terms of the business outcome it delivers, not just what looks good. You're a rare blend of creative and technical: you have genuine taste, and you can execute. That means writing the hook, briefing the edit, or cutting the ad yourself when speed matters more than process. You'll partner closely with the Performance Marketing team to scale paid social into a channel that's driven by creative insight rather than just campaign setup, and to help define Leapsome's creative voice as we continue scaling globally.

What you will do:

Creative Strategy & Positioning

  • Develop the positioning, messaging, and creative angles that make HR and People leaders feel understood rather than marketed to.

  • Find the moments, frustrations, goals, and everyday realities that resonate with real HR practitioners.

  • Translate product and platform experiences into concepts that stop the scroll and drive action.

  • Stay close to the customer: watch competitor ads, read comments, study reviews, and let those insights inform every creative decision.

  • Turn performance data and testing results into sharper creative strategy by identifying what's working, what isn't, and what to try next.

Creative Production

  • Own creative across static image, video/B-roll, and partnership/UGC ads. Lead concepting, briefing, and sign-off end to end.

  • Write the copy that anchors the work: hooks, scripts, on-screen text, static copy, and end cards across video and static formats.

  • Recut and remix existing ads quickly to generate high-volume creative iterations, and cut/produce ads yourself when speed matters more than process.

  • Run creator operations end to end: sourcing, contracting, and whitelisting for UGC and partnership creators.

  • Build a steady pipeline of high-performing creative across categories, with a clear test-and-learn cycle behind every concept.

Paid Social Strategy & Media Buying

  • Independently own and operate paid social accounts day to day across Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube. This includes campaign builds, audience/targeting setup, budget allocation, bid strategy, and QA.

  • Make media buying and creative decisions through an ROI lens, tying output to cost per conversion, conversion rate, and pipeline impact, not just creative quality.

  • Manage and forecast paid social budgets in partnership with the Performance Marketing team.

  • Collaborate closely with Growth, Product Marketing, and Design to keep creative aligned with broader campaign strategy.

Who are we looking for?

  • 3+ years in a performance marketing or creative strategy role, with hands-on ownership of paid social creative and campaign management.

  • A track record you can point to: you led a creative strategy that drove a measurable lift in conversions or sign-ups and moved cost per conversion in the right direction.

  • Obsessed with the customer. You think about who you're talking to before you think about what you want to say.

  • Hands-on experience editing video (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).

  • Experience running creator operations end-to-end (sourcing, briefing, contracting, whitelisting) is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (e.g., Midjourney, Higgsfield, AdCreative.ai, or similar) is a strong plus.

  • Comfort working with performance data (Meta/LinkedIn/YouTube Ads Manager, GA4 or equivalent) to inform creative decisions, not just intuition.

  • Strong project management and communication skills. You can run multiple creative workflows and reviews at once without losing quality control.

  • Quick to pick up new tools: AI creative platforms, editing software, growth analytics. Experience with creative analytics platforms (e.g. Motion) is a plus.

  • Working familiarity with paid search platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads). You'll occasionally pitch in on paid search tasks alongside our freelance paid search support.

Benefits

  • Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform.

  • Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace.

  • Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth.

  • Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network.

  • Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical.

  • Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness.

  • Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

  • Impact: Join a fast-growing HR platform trusted by more than 2,000 companies worldwide: you'll help shape how companies run HR and grow their people in one connected system.

  • Culture: A diverse, international team that values open feedback and celebrates wins, big and small.

  • Sponsored lunch: Lunch is on us every Tuesday and Thursday.

  • Work from anywhere: Work from a different location for up to 2 months a year.

  • Monthly team activities: Join Feierabend, a monthly budget to get-together in Berlin — hosted by employees, for employees.

This role is based in Berlin and the salary range for this position is €80,000 - €100,000 + Bonus + Equity. View our full compensation framework here.

Leapsome aims to pay generously and fairly. If the listed range isn’t working for your situation, please tell us early in the process, we’d rather have that conversation than lose a great candidate over a number we may be able to address.

Leapsome’s values

We stay true to our values in everything we do at Leapsome.

Excited to be part of Leapsome? 😊

A cover letter isn’t necessary, but we’d really appreciate a brief answer to these questions: Why Leapsome? Why you?

We look forward to getting to know you!

Help us make work fulfilling for everyone!

At Leapsome, we want work to be the best it can be for everyone. We help companies create environments where people can achieve shared goals, build authentic relationships, learn, and grow together.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (m/w/d) for telemedicine platform
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei Ocumeda

As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it.
This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling.

  • Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it
  • Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them
  • Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product
  • Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building
  • Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork
  • Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly


Das bringst du mit

  • Strong organisational instincts.

  • Good writing and a sharp eye for brand: you can hold a voice that isn't your own and spot when something drifts off-identity.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: briefs won't always be complete, and we'd rather you make a sensible start than wait for one.

  • Willingness to travel to events and be visibly, energetically present at them. Security or tech industry experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

What you'll get

  • Share options. If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Octopus car scheme. Drive electric through salary sacrifice.

  • Dog-friendly office.

  • Inclusivity as standard. A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.

This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.

  • Represent Rillet

Life at Rillet

  • Benefits that support you. We offer medical and dental coverage, including up to 100% of employee premiums and 90% of dependent premiums, along with a 401(k), flexible PTO, nine company-wide holidays, and paid parental leave for eligible employees.

  • Better together. We’re hybrid-first, with teams centered in New York City and San Francisco, as well as select remote roles. Our offices are stocked with snacks, we regularly provide lunch and dinner, and we make time to connect as a team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join ExTrac's engineering team to help build and operate the services and pipelines the platform runs on.

ExTrac takes a continuously ingested, multi-source corpus and turns it into products analysts use to make decisions under time pressure. You will be responsible for building and running the backend microservices that make that possible: services and databases that expose curated data through APIs, run search and aggregation over large indices, hold application state, and keep the whole thing fast and correct as volume and customer count grow.

The work is broad by design. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own services end to end across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built.

What the job involves

Service design and delivery

  • Take an ambiguous problem, gather requirements, write a technical design, and ship to production with minimal oversight.

  • Own services end to end, including consolidating or decommissioning what they replace.

  • Contribute to and lead system design and architecture decisions.

  • Design APIs used by both internal teams and customers, and hold them to clear contracts and sensible versioning as the number of consumers grows.

  • Treat the storage layer as a design concern rather than an implementation detail: schema, indexing strategy, and access patterns. Establish clear access patterns and boundaries.

Production engineering

  • Develop Go and Python-based microservices to support data collection, processing, and querying.

  • Hold services to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, with the instrumentation in place to know when they are not meeting them.

  • Build and operate high-throughput data streaming pipelines and work on improving scalability, robustness, and latency.

  • Optimise databases and index performance where it is the constraint on product behaviour.

Working with analysts, product, and the ML team

  • Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system.

  • Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon platform work.

  • Partner with the AI and frontend teams to deliver cross-functional features, solving the engineering, performance, and reliability problems that sit outside of their scope.

  • Improve the shared foundations other engineers depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, observability, and the environments their work runs in.

You should apply if

  • You have built and operated production backend systems. You will spend your time working on and owning Go and Python services, databases, and APIs, and you know the difference between something that works on a laptop and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost.

  • You can operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will be trusted to lead projects, make decisions, and drive outcomes. We work on open-ended problems with no established answer, and when the obvious approach fails you generate alternatives rather than stopping.

  • You do not trust a change until you have measured it. Reaching for the profiler, the trace, or the metric is instinct rather than afterthought.

  • You treat quality, security, and observability as engineering fundamentals rather than optional extras, and you make the case for addressing technical debt rather than living with it.

  • You raise the bar for the engineers around you in ways they would recognise: pairing on problems outside your own project, leaving reviews people learn from, and writing things down for the next person.

  • You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences.

Where this role can take you

  • Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means ownership over larger sections of the platform, more architectural say over how our services evolve, and more influence over which problems we take on.

  • Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means service design one month and pipeline or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one.

  • Progress without changing track. ExTrac values the IC and management paths equally: Staff Engineer and Engineering Manager sit at the same level, and taking on reports is not the price of progression.

Requirements

Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand.

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to stand up production-grade services and experience owning features end to end.

  • Proficiency in building microservices using Go or Python.

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, databases, and software engineering patterns.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and with the CI/CD pipelines around them.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable writing clear technical documentation and discussing requirements with colleagues from engineering and the wider team.

  • Breadth across the stack: improving deployment pipelines, understanding database behaviour, and a genuine interest in security engineering.

  • An interest in how the product is actually used, and a willingness to take analyst feedback into requirements discussions rather than treating requirements as someone else's problem.

Desirable

  • Currently working with Go-based microservices.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL.

  • Experience with streaming or event-driven pipelines.

  • Experience with feature flags and trunk-based development. Features land close to weekly, and individual deploys go out several times a day across several projects.

  • Experience operating multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a hard requirement.

  • Experience working in software for defence, government, or other compliance-constrained environments.

Interview Process

  • Initial Intro Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes

  • Technical Assessment - 1 hour

  • Competency-based Interview - 1 hour

  • Founder Interview - 30 Minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working. The team is typically in our central London office two days a week, and you are welcome to come in up to five.

ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

jobs.title: People & Culture Manager
jobs.description:
People & Culture Manager – 12-Month Maternity Cover

Location: Remote (UK-based)
Reporting to: Chief Operations Officer
Contract: 12-month fixed-term contract (maternity cover)
Start date: Approx. November 2026

About Aveni

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

We’ve been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds.

Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re scaling our team to meet that demand.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced People & Culture Manager to join Aveni on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave.

This is a broad, hands-on role with ownership across the full employee lifecycle. You’ll keep our day-to-day People function running smoothly, support employees and managers, oversee our core HR processes and systems, manage our small recruitment team, and continue the delivery of our existing People roadmap.

Aveni is a fast-moving, remote-first AI business where priorities can change quickly. You’ll therefore need to be proactive, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership, balancing BAU HR with projects and adapting your approach as the business evolves.

An investment round is likely during this period, so experience supporting a business through investment, due diligence and associated People requirements would be particularly valuable.

There is also potential for the contract to be extended beyond the initial 12 months, subject to business requirements.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own day-to-day HR: Manage the full employee lifecycle, from onboarding through to offboarding, alongside employee relations, absence and other day-to-day People matters.

  • Manage performance and probation: Keep probation and performance management processes running effectively, supporting managers with feedback, performance conversations, development and appropriate next steps.

  • Support our managers: Be a trusted People partner, providing practical HR guidance and coaching to managers and senior stakeholders.

  • Keep us compliant: Stay ahead of UK employment law and regulatory changes, ensuring our policies, processes and manager guidance remain current and effective.

  • Strengthen our culture: Drive engagement and find creative ways to strengthen connection and cross-functional collaboration across our remote-first team.

  • Manage core People operations: Oversee HiBob, payroll alongside Finance and our external provider, benefits, remuneration, employee records and People reporting.

  • Oversee Talent Acquisition: Manage and support our small recruitment team, recruitment budget and processes, including Ashby.

  • Deliver and improve: Execute our People roadmap, manage operational People risks and lead practical improvements to our HR processes and employee experience.

  • Explore AI in HR: Identify practical and creative opportunities to use AI to make our People processes more efficient and effective.

  • Support business growth: Work closely with the COO and Finance on headcount planning and workforce budgeting, alongside supporting People-related requirements for a potential investment round.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll be an experienced HR generalist who is comfortable operating independently across a broad People remit. You’ll combine strong HR knowledge with practical judgement, empathy and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels.

You’ll bring:

  • Strong generalist HR experience within a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Hands-on experience managing the full employee lifecycle and employee relations.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice.

  • Experience supporting managers with probation, absence and performance management.

  • Confidence advising and coaching managers and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience managing core HR operations, including HR systems, payroll, benefits and employee records.

  • Experience delivering employee engagement, culture or HR improvement initiatives.

  • A proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

  • Sound judgement and a practical, solutions-focused approach to complex People situations.

  • Comfort working with ambiguity and adapting when business priorities change.

  • An empathetic and approachable style, balanced with commercial awareness and the needs of the business.

  • Curiosity about technology and how AI can improve HR processes and ways of working.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or equivalent relevant HR experience.

Experience within a start-up or scaling business, technology, SaaS, AI or financial services would be particularly valuable, as would experience working in a remote-first culture.

Experience with HiBob, Ashby, IR35 or People-related investment due diligence would also be advantageous.

Why This Role Is Different

This isn’t a role where you’ll be working within a large HR function or waiting for someone else to set the direction. You’ll have:

  • Broad ownership across Aveni’s People function.

  • Real autonomy in a fast-moving and evolving business.

  • The opportunity to work closely with managers, founders and our Senior Leadership Team.

  • Scope to strengthen our remote culture and cross-functional collaboration.

  • The freedom to bring creativity and AI into our HR processes.

  • Exposure to an exciting period of growth and potential investment.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys spotting what could work better and then making it happen.

Benefits at Aveni – What You’ll Love

  • Remote-first across the UK, with regular off-sites and in-person gatherings.

  • Work abroad policy.

  • Co-working spaces available.

  • 34 days’ holiday, including flexible bank holidays, plus your birthday off.

  • Company-wide off-sites.

  • Optional Personal Development Plan.

  • Flexible benefits platform.

  • Life Insurance, Income Protection and Critical Illness cover.

  • Pension with up to 5% matched employer contribution, with the option to increase contributions.

  • Private health and dental care.

  • Enhanced family leave.

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work.

If you’re passionate about people, technology and the opportunity to help a growing AI business thrive, we’d love to hear from you.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we’d still like to hear from you if you believe you’d be a great fit.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.
